decisions.text: type stacked_bar: fractions or rough subtotals over time, and the total's change matters: absolute stacks, bars, the particular periods being the point (G1.44, G1.45)
stacking order from the base: East, West, South, North (the largest at the base, where it is read precisely; G7.31, D-26 (b))
each part in one colour and one place in every total: East (slot 1), West (slot 2), South (slot 4), North (slot 3) (G4.22, G7.31)
digits hidden: thousands, stated once on the top label (R2-05, D-3): “$100K in donations”
time axis: row 2 (“2022”) left out, the title gives it (G2.37)
the unit phrase on the top label: “$100K in donations”; the top gridline starts after it
each part named beside the last stack, level with the middle of its segment, top to bottom as stacked: North, South, West, East (G5.4, D-31 (c))
the title wraps onto two lines

source.shows: the same with particular months the point: stacked bars (R7-28, G1.45), thin gaps in the page colour between the segments (G7.32); each region in the colour it has in all six charts of 07 #14 (fixed slots, the book's: East blue, West orange, North olive, South gold; R3-24, G4.22, D-22 (a))
